custom_tab_enabled.description: Master switch. false = never open the custom tab.

custom_tab_url.description: Site opened in the Chrome Custom Tab. Must start with https:// or http://.

custom_tab_every_clicks.description: Open on every Nth tap (1 = every tap, 3 = every 3rd tap).

custom_tab_min_gap_seconds.description: Minimum seconds between two openings (0 = no limit).
